items.text: Hypit 模块更名为视频克隆，统一文本处理、图片创作、视频创作、配音、音效与音乐六种能力名称，并完善各项目的 Agent 接入说明。
items.text_en: Rename Hypit to Video Cloning, unify six capability names, and document capability discovery, result-only runs, and project association for Agents.

items.text: 新增 laohu 账户连接与余额展示，支持登录账户和手动 Key 切换，并固定任务接受时的凭据身份。
items.text_en: Add laohu account connection and balance display, switch between account and manual-key modes, and pin execution identity when a task is accepted.

items.text: 更新 laohu 模型目录与逐模型请求契约，保留待确认能力并加强参数和素材限制校验。
items.text_en: Refresh the laohu model catalog and model-specific request contracts, retain unconfirmed capabilities, and strengthen parameter and media validation.

items.text: 新增五套公众号文章排版主题，更新音乐作品编辑、乐谱与版本选择体验。
items.text_en: Add five article layout themes and improve music editing, score content, and independent version selection.

items.text: 修复 AI 应用字段清空、连接状态和媒体输入映射，保持参数面板滚动与编辑焦点。
items.text_en: Fix explicit empty values, connected-field states, and media mapping in AI applications while preserving parameter-panel scroll and editing focus.

items.text: 限制结果历史快照嵌套，优化任务索引读取缓存，并保留任务恢复和并发修订保护。
items.text_en: Limit nested result-history snapshots, cache task-index reads, and preserve task recovery and revision protection.
